servers.name: issued.live
servers.description: Certificate transparency and DNS: certificates issued for a domain, the addresses it has resolved to, reverse IP lookups and newly registered domains.

auth.notes: Three tools are free without a key. The other tools need a key on the plan they name; called without one they return a tool error that names the plan.

rate_limits.keyless: 1,000 requests per day per client IP, reset at 00:00 UTC
rate_limits.keyed: Basic 60/min, Plus 300/min, Pro 1,200/min, no daily cap; advanced queries allow 1 request in flight on Plus and 2 on Pro

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Certificate record and every address the domain apex has resolved to.

tools.name: recent_certificates
tools.description: Certificates logged in the last 30 minutes, newest first.

tools.name: corpus_stats
tools.description: Corpus size, freshness, DNS coverage, CT log health and top issuers.

tools.name: domain_detail
tools.description: Full record for one domain: registration timing, addresses with network data, and certificates with SANs.

tools.name: domains_on_ip
tools.description: Hostnames observed resolving to one IP address.

tools.name: domains_in_range
tools.description: Hostnames observed on any address in a CIDR range of up to 256 addresses.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: One certificate by cert_id or SHA-256, with its full SAN list.

tools.name: certificates_by_key
tools.description: Certificates issued for one public key (SPKI SHA-256), first seen in the last 32 hours.

tools.name: domain_timeline
tools.description: Dated sequence of zone, certificate and DNS observations for one domain.

tools.name: new_domains
tools.description: Newly registered domains from ICANN zone files, cursor-paged oldest first.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Registrable domains matching a name pattern, optionally by nameserver.

tools.name: lookup_domains
tools.description: Up to 500 domains in one call.

tools.name: provisioning
tools.description: Domains whose registration, first certificate and first DNS answer fall inside a short window.

tools.name: certificates_on_ip
tools.description: Certificates for the hostnames observed on one IP address, in issuance order.

tools.name: list_dataset_files
tools.description: Bulk dataset files the subscription can download today.

servers.name: curlhub.sh
servers.description: Converts a structured HTTP request into a curl command with verified escaping, as a shell string and an argv array.

rate_limits.keyless: 60 requests per minute per client IP, shared with the curlhub.sh transform tools

tools.name: validate_and_format_curl
tools.description: Build a curl command from method, URL, headers and body; rejects non-http(s) schemes and control characters.

servers.name: webshot.site
servers.description: Renders a screenshot or PDF of a public URL in an isolated headless Chrome sandbox and returns a link to the file.

auth.notes: Keyless calls use the free credit bucket. A paid key bills the key's plan. An invalid key returns 401.

rate_limits.keyless: 5 credits per 15 minutes per client IP; a viewport capture costs 1 credit, full_page costs 2
rate_limits.keyed: Set by the key's plan (Starter, Pro, Business)

tools.name: capture_sandbox_webshot
tools.description: Screenshot or PDF of a public URL at desktop, tablet or mobile size; private and metadata addresses are refused.

servers.name: webfetch.io
servers.description: Fetches web pages as markdown, text or HTML, extracts structured JSON with CSS or XPath selectors, and runs Google, Bing, Yahoo and Brave searches.

auth.notes: Every call needs a key. A free account starts with 1,000 credits and gets 250 more on the 1st of each month.

rate_limits.keyed: Credit-metered: 1 credit per plain fetch, 5 with JavaScript rendering, 10 per search page (15 with light_request false). Concurrency is 5 on Free and 25 to 400 on paid plans. A failed call costs nothing.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a URL as markdown, text or HTML; 5 credits rendered, 1 credit with render_js false.

tools.name: extract_data
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return JSON built from CSS or XPath selector rules.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: One page of search results as JSON from Google, Bing, Yahoo or Brave; needs search access enabled on the key.

servers.name: WorldIP.io
servers.description: IP intelligence for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses: owner, ASN, geolocation, CIDR, reverse and forward-confirmed DNS, and a daily count of hosted domains.

rate_limits.keyless: 1,000 requests per day and 60 per minute per client IP

tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Profile of a public IPv4 or IPv6 address: owner, ASN, location, CIDR, PTR and forward-confirmed DNS.

tools.name: whats_my_ip
tools.description: The caller's own public IP address and its profile.
